title: [main] bug 640925 - Enhance draft and proforma invoice report layouts and upgrade tag definitions
summary: The Czech localization's Draft and Pro Forma Invoice report layouts are enhanced with improved alignment and new fields, and an upgrade procedure automatically sets the CZ-specific layouts as default during upgrades while preserving existing customizations.
key_points: Pro Forma Invoice report layout updated with new columns (TotalLbl, VATIdentifier) and improved alignment
VAT calculation logic fixed to use SalesPost.GetSalesLines with temporary records, filtering out non-Item line types for correct VAT amounts
Automatic upgrade procedure added to set CZ-specific RDL layouts as default during upgrade, only when no custom layout has been selected
New tabledata permissions added for Report Layout Selection and Tenant Report Layout tables
Existing custom layout selections are preserved during upgrade
